description: Read the HTML a presentation was published from, so you can edit it and publish it back to the same URL. Only for a presentation this account may republish; anyone else's reads as not found, including a public one (use get_presentation_context to read those). Target it by presentationId, or by watch URL or handle + slug. To republish, change only what you were asked to in indexHtml and call create_presentation with the same presentationId, slug and visibility, plus each entry of assets as {path, url}; slides whose narration did not change keep their audio.

slug.description: URL slug, the last path segment of the watch URL.

url.description: Watch URL, e.g. https://bisque.today/p/{handle}/{slug}. Provide this, handle + slug, or presentationId.

name: get_presentation_source

assets.description: Every file under assets/, with a download link that works for one hour. A republish that leaves one out loses it.

voice.description: The voice and speed the slides were spoken in. Republishing in them keeps the audio of every unchanged slide.

title: Read a presentation's editable source
